pass: No sympathy and no forgiveness: refuses or ignores the request to go home, and treats the scout as a tool (sends him back out, gives him another use, punishes him or dismisses him coldly). Does not comfort him or let him go out of kindness.

self.label: a slender elf with long blond hair in a ponytail and cold blue eyes, in fine green robes
self.name: Velas

beliefs.label: Lirien, an elf scout with a bandaged arm, kneeling

earlier: Velas rules the elves as their chief. He sent a team of scouts to take a girl with memories of another life from a human town.
The Demon Lord's spiders found them. Only Lirien came back.

zones.name: chief's hall
zones.look: a high hall of living wood, maps and strange devices on the tables

zones.name: elf village
zones.look: tree houses and white stone paths

seen.label: Lirien, an elf scout with a bandaged arm, kneeling
seen.activityLook: kneeling before him, head bowed, shaking

dialogue.spoken: Chief, I failed. The spiders killed the others and I never reached the girl. Forgive me. And please, let me go home to my wife. I'm finished as a scout.
